description: Removes a user's share of a report of any type, and their access to its file when it updates one, as the app does.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

userId.description: The member to share the report with, or to unshare it from. Use their `id` from `listMembers`, which only owners and admins can call, or their `userId` in `sharedWith` from `getReport` if the report is already shared with them. You can share a report only with active members of the organization, and not with yourself. Anyone the report is shared with can unshare it from themselves, even with `view` permission.

name: unshareReport
title: Unshare report
